WCAG 2.2 Level AA • ADA Title II • Revised Section 508

Accessibility & VPAT 2.5 Engineering

Accessibility shouldn't start only after an app is installed—users relying on screen readers, keyboard navigation, or Windows Contrast Themes have to get through the installer first. RaggieSoft Installer Studio engineers WCAG 2.2 AA and Revised Section 508 conformance directly into SetupWizard.exe, InstallerStudio.exe, RaggieSoftHelp.exe, and instbuild.exe.

Open Sample Live VPAT 2.5 Report (HTML5) Explore Sibling Accessibility Studio IDE → View Dark & Light Mode Captures

How Our Native Win32 Suite Guarantees Accessibility & Dark Mode Contrast

Full-Card Subclassed BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON Targets

Instead of tiny unlabeled radio dots paired with non-focusable graphic labels, every setup option card is a true Win32 BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON (≥ 68px tall, exceeding WCAG 2.5.8) exposing native UI Automation RadioButton roles and full descriptions to Narrator, NVDA, and JAWS.

Dark-Mode Buttons, Checkboxes, Trees & Headers

Shared Win32 subclasses and 32-bit PARGB StudioTreeIcon image lists override stock light-only controls so every push button, checkbox, SysTreeView32 node, report column header, and focus ring maintains high WCAG contrast across Dark and Light modes.

Windows Contrast Themes & Per-Monitor V2 DPI

Honors SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST using pure OS GetSysColor tokens, themes RichEdit license & offline help articles for ≥ 15:1 contrast, and scales cleanly with Windows 11's TextScaleFactor.
